==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact}} Read Sigrika's WavesLine message
{{WavesLine|text = :'''Sigrika:''' Senior, do you remember Denia? You met her at the New Solar Celebration. She was the one who got us those tickets.
:'''Sigrika:''' She's been in the infirmary since the last incident. They're saying she's still not in any condition to take visitors.
:'''Sigrika:''' If it's not too much trouble, could you check on her for me? I've been asking N.A.N.A. for updates, but she tells me the same thing every time... I'm worried.
:{Choice} Got it.
::'''(Rover):''' Got it.
:'''Sigrika:''' Appreciate you, Senior! ヾ(ﾟ▽ﾟ)ノ}}
----
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 1.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' She's right, little one... You might still have a way out.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 2.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' Because your suffering is nothing like hers. It cannot make you stronger, but neither will it last...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 3.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' Enough staring at the dead bird, Denia.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 4.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Why did you kill it?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 5.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' What's worthless doesn't deserve to continue, see? That was mercy.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 6.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' Just hours ago, you accepted Aleph-1's gift, the first in this world to do so. Now tell me, how did it feel?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 7.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I felt... nothing.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 8.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' So, nothingness. The void. The dark... Our good old friends.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 9.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' But why do you tremble, Denia? Everything begins in the void. And you, most of all, should find it cosy...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 10.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Why... did you kill it?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 11.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' Heh... Self-awareness. A lamentable flaw in the course of evolution.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 12.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' Now, look up, Denia. What do you see?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 13.ogg}} '''Denia:''' ...The void... and the dark.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 14.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' Good. Remember what you've seen.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 15.ogg}} '''Nivora:''' You will accept them, Denia. Become one with them. This is the world's first gift to you, and its last.
----
:In time, we will all meet again in eternal darkness.
----
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 17.ogg}} '''Denia:''' No...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 18.ogg}} '''N.A.N.A.:''' Vital signs indicate sustained recovery. Voidmatter activity remains within normal parameters. Target frequency has not yet returned to the syntony level. Initiating secondary protocol.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 90 19.ogg}} '''N.A.N.A.:''' Can you hear my voice, Denia?
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact}} Check WavesLine
{{WavesLine|text = :'''Arman:''' Hi {{Rover}}. This is Arman from the Spacetrek Collective. Can you come by now?
:'''Arman:''' Denia is awake and being kept in isolation at the infirmary. We'd like to work with you on her case.
:{Choice} Sure.
::'''(Rover):''' Sure.
:'''Arman:''' Much appreciated. See you soon.}}
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Head to the infirmary
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 2 1.ogg}} '''Abby:''' So, Denia... You think she's alright?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 2 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 2 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Denia... The Fractsidus made no move while she was unconscious. Have they really abandoned what they worked so hard to achieve? Or are they biding their time for something else?)
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 2 3 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 2 3 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Let's go see for ourselves.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests Optional}} Head to the infirmary
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 3 1.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Impossible. We will not agree to that condition...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 3 2.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Please relay this message, Madam President. I'll take full responsibility.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Accept the commission
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 1.ogg}} '''Arman:''' {{Rover}} is here. Yes, I understand. Please rest assured.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 2.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Sorry to pull you in on such short notice, {{Rover}}. I'm Arman, I sent the message. The situation's worse than we anticipated, so I'll keep it short.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 3 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 3 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' How's Denia?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 4.ogg}} '''Arman:''' She's... awake. But just as we feared, the Fractsidus did something to her.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 5.ogg}} '''Arman:''' After waking up, her frequency deteriorated rapidly into systemic failure. According to Rabelle College's estimate, she has... one week. At best.
:{{DIcon}} What's gone wrong?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 7.ogg}} '''Arman:''' No idea. There's not enough time to even determine whether it's physiological... or caused by the Threnodian.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 8.ogg}} '''Arman:''' The New Federation is pressing charges over the Stridergate incident and the residual frequency on the Dimmr Plains. They want Denia handed over immediately.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 9.ogg}} '''Arman:''' We didn't comply, of course. Denia was a Startorch Academy student. Sending her there would turn her into a mere research subject... and cost us our only chance to reach the truth or contest the charges.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 10 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 10 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I see the picture... When you say "contest the charges," are you suggesting Denia is the key to breaking this stalemate?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 11.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Exactly. First, her connection to the Voidborne Threnodian has enormous research value. Even with the Stridergate sealed, she could open new directions for Voidmatter science.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 12.ogg}} '''Arman:''' And based on I.R.I.S.'s review of our prior interactions, Denia likely knows the source of the Threnodian frequency on the Dimmr Plains. The reason why her condition is worsening, too.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 13.ogg}} '''Arman:''' If she is willing to cooperate, we can resolve this before the New Fed forces our hand. We treat her. She helps with the report. It'll be a win-win, ideally.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 14 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 14 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Sounds like that didn't go very smoothly.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 15.ogg}} '''Arman:''' No. She's been... resistant. To any form of contact.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 16.ogg}} '''Arman:''' This is where we need you, {{Rover}}. I'm sure you understand, mental stability is a prerequisite for frequency control. You have prior contact with her, and... your experience with Threnodians also makes you a safer anchor in the negotiation.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 17 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 17 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Denia might be a viable opening. But until I figure out what the Fractsidus is planning and where they are now, I shouldn't commit to anything reckless.)
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 18 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 18 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I will speak to her and make my judgment from there.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 19 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 19 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Also, I want this meeting kept off the record. No files, not even in I.R.I.S.'s archive.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 4 20.ogg}} '''Arman:''' ...Understood. Then I'll leave this in your hands, {{Rover}}. Her identity is only known to very few now, I can assure you.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests Optional}} Talk to Arman
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 1.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Anything else you want to confirm, {{Rover}}?
:{{DIcon}} Any progress on tracking the Threnodian frequency?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 6.ogg}} '''Arman:''' We've narrowed down the location, but Voidmatter contamination there is heavy, so cleanup and investigation will be slow. That said, recent spectral analysis points to a direct correlation between the frequency and Denia's physical condition.
:{{DIcon}} How was Denia acting when she spoke with you?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 7.ogg}} '''Arman:''' "Cold" is the word. So cold that even N.A.N.A. can't establish any meaningful contact. We are still not sure if the Threnodian did this, but she is not the Denia we knew.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 8 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 8 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' You've met Denia before?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 9.ogg}} '''Arman:''' I have. Back then, I was teaching a required course in Voidmatters Science, and she slept through a good portion of it, so I remember her.
:{{DIcon}} That call earlier, was it Lucilla?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 10.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Yes. The President is busy smoothing things over with some big names. She asked me to send her regards.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 11.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Oh, and she also has a message for you: "Only the kids who make it out alive get to grow up."
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 12 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 12 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Is that supposed to be about Denia?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 5 13.ogg}} '''Arman:''' I honestly don't know. But that's her... always leaving you guessing.
:{{DIcon}} That's all.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Enter the Academy infirmary
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 6 1 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 6 1 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Whatever her reason was for saving me and Hiyuki back then... she still carried out the Fractsidus's plan.)
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 6 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 6 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (And the Grand Architect's next move is still unclear... Have to stay cautious.)
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Talk to Denia
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 1 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 1 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Denia.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 2.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I just saw Sigrika. That was crazy, {{Rover}}. I didn't think you'd actually... you know, drive that thing off.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 3.ogg}} '''Denia:''' So... you're just gonna keep staring? Do you always come empty-handed when you visit patients?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 4 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 4 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Looks like she's free of the Threnodian's influence now... but that way of talking...)
:{{DIcon}} Are you aware of your condition right now?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 6.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Yeah. I'm dying, right?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 7.ogg}} '''Denia:''' That person gave me a gift a long time ago... Said when the time comes, I'd finally get a nice sleep.
:{{DIcon}} A gift?
:{{DIcon}} What is it exactly?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 10.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Who knows. But it's not hard to guess, is it? Just like a collar you put on cats and dogs, in case they get ideas.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 11.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Mm, no. "Cats and dogs" might be too generous. At least they can still bite. I'm probably closer to a lab mouse now.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 12.ogg}} '''Denia:''' So, {{Rover}}, did they send you to sweet-talk a lab mouse?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 13 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 13 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Denia, I'm here because I chose to be.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 14 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 14 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' We've been on opposite sides before, but...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 15.ogg}} '''Denia:''' There you go, still all serious...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 16 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 16 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' But I want to try trusting you.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 17.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Right... In that case, am I supposed to look more excited?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 18.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Too bad, {{Rover}}, I can't trust you in the same way.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 19.ogg}} '''Denia:''' You saw me at my worst there, and you're still playing this game... You want answers. That's why you're here.
:{{DIcon}} I won't deny it.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 22.ogg}} '''Denia:''' How honest. I don't hate that.
:{{DIcon}} You did save me once.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 23.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Hah... don't get the wrong idea... If you'd died back there, it would have been game over.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 24.ogg}} '''Denia:''' If you really want answers, how about we make a deal?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 25 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 25 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' A deal?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 26.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Yes, a fair exchange. The Collective can't get what they want from me, but you just might get what you want.
:{{DIcon}} What's your condition?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 28.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Maybe you could stay with me for my birthday? This weekend. I'd like to have a good stroll in the Academy again.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 29 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 29 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Your birthday is this weekend?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 30.ogg}} '''Denia:''' It could be, or not. Doesn't matter. What matters is... you are there.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 31.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I'm running out of time. Some things deserve a proper ending—with a good day.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 32 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 32 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (An ending... What is she planning to do? But in her current state...)
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 33.ogg}} '''Denia:''' What, doesn't feel safe even if you're around? Then put another collar on me, or a bomb. What's one more, right?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 34 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 34 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' ...I'll see what I can do.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 35.ogg}} '''Denia:''' You mean that? But people at the Academy, do they know...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 36 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 36 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Spacetrek Collective never made your identity public. So for that day, you'll still be the Academy student Denia.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 37.ogg}} '''Denia:''' (Always the busybody.)
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 38.ogg}} '''Denia:''' ...Fine. Then it's a deal, right?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 39.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Relax. I'll cooperate with their research for the next few days. Just don't get your hopes up...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 40.ogg}} '''Denia:''' ...The Grand Architect wouldn't be sloppy enough to leave me unhandled.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 7 41.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Anyway, no point worrying about it now. I'll see you this weekend, {{Rover}}.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests Optional}} Keep talking to Denia
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 1.ogg}} '''Denia:''' {{Rover}}... Something's still bothering you?
:{{DIcon}} What do you know about the Grand Architect?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 6.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I've never seen her true face. Wouldn't be surprised if the real one's already dead.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 7.ogg}} '''Denia:''' You care about that, do you? I'll tell you more once you've kept your side of the deal.
:{{DIcon}} Do you miss life at the Academy?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 8.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Miss my life at the Academy? What made you think that?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 9 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 9 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' You keep staring out the window. That's where the dorms are.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 10.ogg}} '''Denia:''' ...When you put it that way, maybe I do. The president once said that everyone ends up missing their school days when they grow up.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 11.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I guess that really was my golden age.
:{{DIcon}} Why did the Grand Architect leave you there?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 12.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Trash gets dumped, you know... And those little tricks of mine? She probably noticed long ago.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 13.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Or maybe... she simply decided it was better if I died here.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 14.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Because you always try to save everyone, even someone like me... Heh. That kind of stubbornness must have gotten to her.
:{{DIcon}} Nothing.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 9 15.ogg}} '''Denia:''' See you this weekend, {{Rover}}.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Report what happened to Arman
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 1.ogg}} '''Arman:''' {{Rover}}. How did it go? Is she willing to cooperate?
:You pass along Denia's request to Arman
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 3.ogg}} '''Arman:''' A birthday... at the Academy?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 4.ogg}} '''Arman:''' ...I see. That is an unexpected request.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 5.ogg}} '''Arman:''' But if that's the key to cooperation, the Collective will treat it as a special case.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 6 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 6 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' She said she wants a "proper ending" for some things. But I don't know her true intent yet. We'd better be careful.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 7.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Noted. We'll initiate a full risk assessment immediately, and draft a comprehensive operational and contingency plan.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 8.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Thank you, {{Rover}}. Would you be available in the afternoons of this weekend? She asked for you specifically.
:{{DIcon}} No problem.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 11.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Much appreciated. We'll ensure that all procedures and contingency measures are fully in place.
:{{DIcon}} I'll do my best.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 12.ogg}} '''Arman:''' We really appreciate your support! I know this is a very personal request, but we'll keep everything under control. You can think of it as a special escort mission.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 8 13.ogg}} '''Arman:''' I'll send you the finalized plan before then. Let's stay in touch on WavesLine!
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact}} Check WavesLine
{{WavesLine|text = :'''Arman:''' {{Rover}}, the approvals are through. Everything is set. You can pick up Denia at the station.}}
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Pick Denia up
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 11 1.ogg}} '''Arman:''' You're here, {{Rover}}. The procedure and contact list have been sent to your Terminal. All steps and contingency measures are included.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 11 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 11 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Very detailed. I see a Resonance suppression device and declared contact entries. Everyone's agreed on those?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 11 3.ogg}} '''Arman:''' Yes. At Denia's request, we used her Terminal to schedule the meetings under a recovery discharge notice. She'll be approaching them today as a student.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 11 4.ogg}} '''Arman:''' The suppression device was... her idea, a guarantee of cooperation. She said it would make things fair, even though she doesn't really need it in her current state.

:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 14.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I was a child who showed up at the Fractsidus's door out of nowhere. Became their Threnodian lab mouse by accident. Ever since I can remember, they told me I existed for one reason... to make that moment happen.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 15.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I've questioned myself countless times: What is the point of everything that I've been through?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 16.ogg}} '''Denia:''' The answer is always the same. There is no point. Birth, pain, struggle, death... None of these have meaning.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 17.ogg}} '''Denia:''' That's why when I first heard your story from the Grand Architect, I absolutely hated you, {{Rover}}.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 18.ogg}} '''Denia:''' If someone like that is actually out there... then where were they during the longest, most painful days of my life?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 19.ogg}} '''Denia:''' And why... why would you appear before me just as everything was about to end?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 20.ogg}} '''Denia:''' You know what I hated most? Why did everything about you have to be so impossible?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 21.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Our encounter was... never fair.
(''Story image: T_Main_03_03_C_01_Male'')
(''Story image: T_Main_03_03_C_01_Female'')
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 22.ogg}} '''Denia:''' So, I hope you can forgive me for not saying goodbye. This is something I must put an end to on my own.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 23.ogg}} '''Denia:''' It's just... it hurts to watch the way you live, {{Rover}}... I can't even imagine a day when someone like you runs out of miracles.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 24.ogg}} '''Denia:''' They call you Rover, but you don't even know where you started or where you're going... Even if you made your ideals real... where would that leave you? Where is your happiness in all of that?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 25.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I never understood what the Grand Architect was mumbling. The future, evolution, or what's going to happen eons later—
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 26.ogg}} '''Denia:''' But at that moment, in front of Aleph-1, I didn't want you to die. At least not at the hands of the Grand Architect, who's got nothing left but mere survival.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 27.ogg}} '''Denia:''' What surprised me was that... despite hating you so much, I actually spent such an unprecedented day with you.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 28.ogg}} '''Denia:''' For the first time, I had my own birthday. For the first time, I forgot about the fear brought by the void. For the first time... I met someone I can truly open up to.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 29.ogg}} '''Denia:''' How should I describe this emotion? It's a kind of hate, isn't it?
(''Story image: T_Main_03_03_C_04'')
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 30.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I don't know where Voidmatter particles will take me next... if I could start over, I'd like to visit the cities Nastasha talked about, to visit places where there are no Void Storms and Soliskin.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 31.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Maybe I'll try picking a different major, try napping in different classes, and taste different cakes in every cafeteria I go to...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 32.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Then, no matter how many times it'll take, I'll come back to Lahai-Roi, back to all of you.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 33.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Whatever you wanted to say, you can tell me the next time we meet.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 34.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Oh, I almost forgot something important... Actually, all those powers the Grand Architect displayed, including shapeshifting, are not her true Forte.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 35.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Those are derivatives at best... And the shapeshifting has a catch: she needs long-term observation and analysis of her target to pull it off.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 36.ogg}} '''Denia:''' It's just... the idea of her using my face to talk to you... it makes me sick. So let's have a code word. Just between us.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 37.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Next time, if it's truly me... all my old "hates" will become "likes."
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 65 38.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Oh, and could you help me enjoy half of my birthday cake? You can save the whole thing for me, of course. But don't you throw away any of the toppings.

:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 67 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 67 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' We will.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 67 3.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Okay... But, what about the thing you didn't get to say, {{Rover}}?

:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Denia... Do you have any clues about that scene in your memory?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 3.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Nothing.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 4.ogg}} '''Denia:''' It was just a scene. Maybe from some movies I watched as a kid?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 5 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 5 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' But maybe... in my opinion... you still have a chance to...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 6.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Now you're reminding me of what Nastasha once said.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 7 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 7 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Huh?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 8.ogg}} '''Denia:''' "Raise your head, what do you see?"
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 9 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 9 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Lahai-Roi's night sky.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 10.ogg}} '''Denia:''' True enough. But my reply was "The void. The darkness."
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 11 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 11 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' What was her reaction?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 12.ogg}} '''Denia:''' She said it was actually light fighting against darkness.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 13.ogg}} '''Denia:''' "But it looks like darkness has the upper hand," I said.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 14 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 14 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' But there was only darkness in Lahai-Roi at the beginning. Then came the light.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 15.ogg}} '''Denia:''' Haha, you answered exactly the same way as she did.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 16 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 16 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' So light actually prevailed.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 17.ogg}} '''Denia:''' You're right, {{Rover}}.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi zrjdykx 68 18.ogg}} '''Denia:''' I guess if you never give up, the story will one day have a good ending, no?
